## This qmd will compare the results obtained from human observation and from the HOG algorithm.

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Libraries
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(tectonicr)
library(jpeg)
library(ggimage)
library(here)
```

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Load datasets
human_df <- read_csv(here("output/wind_summaries/humangrassanalysis.csv"))
hog_df <- read_csv(here("output/weighted_datasets/all_weighted_dataset.csv"))
dates_df <- read_csv(here("output/weighted_datasets/dates_dataset.csv")) # to obtained when photos were taken
monthly_wind_df <- read_csv(here("output/wind_summaries/winddataanalysis.csv"))

```

```{r}
# Save dfs
output_dir <- here("output/datasets")

write_csv(human_df, file.path(output_dir, "human_df.csv"))
write_csv(hog_df, file.path(output_dir, "hog_df.csv"))
write_csv(dates_df, file.path(output_dir, "dates_df.csv"))
write_csv(monthly_wind_df, file.path(output_dir, "monthly_wind_df.csv"))

```

```{r}
# Calculate distances between human vs hog
diff_df <- data.frame(
  image = hog_df$image_name,
  human_angle = human_df$circular_mean,
  hog_angle = hog_df$circular_mean,
  circular_distance = circular_distance(human_df$circular_mean, hog_df$circular_mean, axial = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE))

diff_df

write_csv(diff_df, file.path(output_dir, "diff_df.csv"))
```

```{r}
# Mean circular distance
diff_df %>% summarise(mean(circular_distance), min(circular_distance), max(circular_distance), var(circular_distance))
```

```{r}
# Find images with minimum angle differences
diff_df %>% slice_min(circular_distance, n = 10)

```

```{r}
# Find images with maximum angle differences 
diff_df %>% slice_max(circular_distance, n = 10)
```

```{r}
# Add the date an image was taken to the df
diff_df <- 
  diff_df %>%
  left_join(
    dates_df %>% select(image_name, date_taken),
    by = c("image" = "image_name")
  ) %>%
  mutate(month = month(date_taken)) %>% select(image, month, hog_angle, human_angle, circular_distance)
```


```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# List of image names
images <- c("LL grass24 March 2023", "DJI_0362", "DJI_0346", "DJI_0358",
            "LL grass10 March 2023", "DJI_0363", "DJI_0373",
            "LL grass4 March 2023", "LL grass9 March 2023", "DJI_0345", "DJI_0357", "DJI_0365") # DJI_0357 is one with high circular_distance
```

```{r}
# A filtered df with hog_angle and human_angles of only the selected images
filtered_df <- diff_df %>% filter(image %in% images)

write_csv(filtered_df, file.path(output_dir, "filtered_df.csv"))
```

```{r}
# Add the date an image was taken to the df
filtered_df <- 
  filtered_df %>%
  left_join(
    dates_df %>% select(image_name, date_taken),
    by = c("image" = "image_name")
  ) %>%
  mutate(month = month(date_taken)) %>% select(image, month, hog_angle, human_angle, circular_distance)
  
filtered_df
```

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=16, fig.height=20}
# create a df to combine image files
all_df <- data.frame()

# loops through the images to create file of filtered images' gradients (angles and mags) 
# to create a plot of gradients of grass in the image
for (image in images) {
  file_path <- here("output/angles_mags", paste0(image, ".csv"))
  df <- read_csv(file_path)
  df$image <- image   # add image col
  all_df <- bind_rows(all_df, df)
}

# create plots and facet wrap them
images_facet <- ggplot(all_df, aes(x = theta)) + # this draws the plot of the gradients of the image
  geom_histogram(
    colour = "black", 
    fill = "darkgreen", 
    breaks = seq(0, 360, length.out = 17.5)
  ) +
  coord_polar(theta = "x", start = 0, direction = 1) + # this makes it a polar plot
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 360),
    breaks = c(0, 45, 90, 135, 180, 225, 270, 315),
    labels = c("N", "NE", "E", "SE", "S", "SW", "W", "NW")
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~image, ncol = 3) +
  # Add the human circular_mean arrow
  geom_segment(
    data = filtered_df,
    aes(
      x = human_angle,
      xend = human_angle,
      y = 0,
      yend = 8000
    ),
    color = "black" ,
    size = 1.5,
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")),
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  # Add the HOG circular_mean arrow
  geom_segment(
    data = filtered_df,
    aes(
      x = hog_angle,
      xend = hog_angle,
      y = 0,
      yend = 8000
    ),
    color = "#F0E442",
    size = 1.5,
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")),
    inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 10, b = 0, l = 10), 
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    axis.title.y = element_blank()
    )

images_facet

# Save the image
ggsave(here("media/images_facet.jpg"), 
       images_facet, 
       width = 20, 
       height = 18, 
       dpi = 300)

```

```{r}
# blurry_images
# Placing the hog and human dominant directions onto the image

# Center coordinates 
center_x <- 200
center_y <- 200

# Radius for arrows
r <- 180

arrow_df <- diff_df %>%
  filter(image == "DJI_0357") %>%
  mutate(
    human_rad = human_angle * pi / 180,
    hog_rad   = hog_angle * pi / 180
  )

blurry_images <- ggplot() +
  # Add the image to the plot
  geom_image(
    data = data.frame(x = center_x, y = center_y),
    aes(x, y),
    image = here("images/DJI_0357.JPG"),
    size = 1.2
  ) +
  # Add the human dominant direction arrow
  geom_segment(
    data = arrow_df,
    aes(
      x = center_x,
      y = center_y,
      xend = center_x + r * cos(human_rad),
      yend = center_y + r * sin(human_rad)
      ),
      color = "black",
    size = 4,
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm"))
  ) +
  # Add the HOG dominant direction arrow
  geom_segment(
    data = arrow_df,
    aes(
      x = center_x,
      y = center_y,
      xend = center_x + r * cos(hog_rad),
      yend = center_y + r * sin(hog_rad)
      ), 
    color = "#F0E442",
    size = 4,
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm"))
  ) +
  coord_fixed(xlim = c(0, 400), ylim = c(0, 400)) +
  theme_void() + 
  theme(
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank()
  )

# Save the image
ggsave(here("media/blurry_images.png"), 
       blurry_images, 
       width = 10, 
       height = 8, 
       dpi = 300)

```

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=16, fig.height=20}
# Create plots of the monthly wind data and facet wrap them
monthplots <- ggplot(
  monthly_wind_df %>%
    filter(month %in% c(4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9)) %>%
    mutate(month = factor(
      month,
      levels = 4:9,
      labels = c("Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep")
    )),
  aes(x = circular_mean)
) +
  geom_histogram(
    colour = "black", 
    fill = "lightblue", 
    breaks = seq(0, 360, length.out = 20)
  ) +
  coord_polar(theta = "x", start = 0, direction = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 360),
    breaks = c(0, 45, 90, 135, 180, 225, 270, 315),    
    labels = c("N", "NE", "E", "SE", "S", "SW", "W", "NW")

  facet_wrap(~month, ncol = 3) +
  geom_vline(data = diff_df %>% filter(image == "LL grass24 March 2023")%>%select(image, hog_angle), aes(xintercept = hog_angle, color = "LL grass24 March 2023"), linewidth = 1.5) +
    geom_vline(data = diff_df %>% filter(image == "DJI_0362")%>%select(image, hog_angle), aes(xintercept = hog_angle, color = "DJI_0362"), linewidth = 1.5) +

    geom_vline(data = diff_df %>% filter(image == "DJI_0358")%>%select(image, hog_angle), aes(xintercept = hog_angle, color = "DJI_0358"), linewidth = 1.5) +
    geom_vline(data = diff_df %>% filter(image == "LL grass10 March 2023")%>%select(image, hog_angle), aes(xintercept = hog_angle, color = "LL grass10 March 2023"), linewidth = 1.5) +
    geom_vline(data = diff_df %>% filter(image == "DJI_0363")%>%select(image, hog_angle), aes(xintercept = hog_angle, color = "DJI_0363"), linewidth = 1.5) +
  geom_vline(data = diff_df %>% filter(image == "DJI_0373")%>%select(image, hog_angle), aes(xintercept = hog_angle, color = "DJI_0373"), linewidth = 1.5) +
  #geom_vline(data = filtered_df %>% filter(image == "LL grass4 March 2023")%>%select(image, hog_angle), aes(xintercept = hog_angle, color = "LL grass4 March 2023"), linewidth = 1.5) +
  geom_vline(data = diff_df %>% filter(image == "LL grass9 March 2023")%>%select(image, hog_angle), aes(xintercept = hog_angle, color = "LL grass9 March 2023"), linewidth = 1.5) +
  geom_vline(data = diff_df %>% filter(image == "DJI_0345")%>%select(image, hog_angle), aes(xintercept = hog_angle, color = "DJI_0345"), linewidth = 1.5) +
```

```{r}
# For the selected image with minimal circular distance, place it's hog and human angles on top of the month's polar plot
# Selected image is DJI_O345
ggplot(monthly_wind_df %>% filter(month==4), aes(x = circular_mean)) +
  geom_histogram(
    colour = "black", 
    fill = "lightblue", 
    breaks = seq(0, 360, length.out = 20)
  ) +
  coord_polar(theta = "x", start = 0, direction = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 360),
    breaks = c(0, 45, 90, 135, 180, 225, 270, 315),
    labels = c("N", "NE", "E", "SE", "S", "SW", "W", "NW")
  ) +
  # Add the human circular_mean arrow
  geom_segment(
    data = filtered_df %>% filter(image == "DJI_0345"),
    aes(
      x = human_angle,
      xend = human_angle,
      y = 0,
      yend = 10, 
      color = factor("Human", levels = c("Human", "HOG"))
    ),
    size = 1.5,
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")),
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  # Add the HOG circular_mean arrow
  geom_segment(
    data = filtered_df %>% filter(image == "DJI_0345"),
    aes(
      x = hog_angle,
      xend = hog_angle,
      y = 0,
      yend = 10, 
      color = factor("HOG", levels = c("Human", "HOG"))
    ),
    size = 1.5,
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")),
    inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
  scale_color_manual(             
    values = c("Human" = "black", "HOG" = "#F0E442"),
    name = "Dominant Direction By"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "A Polar Plot of Wind Direction Distribution in April, 2023") +
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 10, b = 0, l = 10), 
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
    )
```

```{r}
# DJI_0345 HOG

# Center coordinates 
center_x <- 200
center_y <- 100

# Radius for arrows
r <- 120

arrow_df <- filtered_df %>%
  filter(image == "DJI_0345") %>%
  mutate(
    human_rad = human_angle * pi / 180,
    hog_rad   = hog_angle * pi / 180
  )

ggplot() +
  # Add the image to the plot
  geom_image(
    data = data.frame(x = center_x, y = center_y),
    aes(x, y),
    image = here("images/DJI_0345.JPG"),
    size = 1.2
  ) +
  # Add the HOG dominant direction arrow
  geom_segment(
    data = arrow_df,
    aes(
      x = center_x,
      y = center_y,
      xend = center_x + r * cos(hog_rad),
      yend = center_y + r * sin(hog_rad),
      color = "HOG"
    ),
    size = 1.5,
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm"))

  # Add a legend

  coord_fixed(xlim = c(0, 400), ylim = c(0, 200)) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(magick)

# Read image + get dimensions
img <- image_read(here("images/DJI_0345.JPG"))
info <- image_info(img)

img_width <- info$width
img_height <- info$height

# Center coordinates (image space)
center_x <- img_width / 2
center_y <- img_height / 2

# Radius for arrows (tune in pixel space)
r <- 1000

arrow_df <- filtered_df %>%
  filter(image == "DJI_0345") %>%
  mutate(
    hog_rad = hog_angle * pi / 180
  )

ggplot() +
  # background image in true aspect ratio space
  annotation_raster(
    raster = as.raster(img),
    xmin = 0,
    xmax = img_width,
    ymin = 0,
    ymax = img_height
  ) +
  
  # HOG direction arrow
  geom_segment(
    data = arrow_df,
    aes(
      x = center_x,
      y = center_y,
      xend = center_x + r * cos(hog_rad),
      yend = center_y + r * sin(hog_rad),
      color = "HOG"
    ),
    linewidth = 1.2,
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm"))
  ) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = c("HOG" = "#F0E442"), name = "Direction") +
  
  coord_fixed(
    xlim = c(0, img_width),
    ylim = c(0, img_height),
    expand = FALSE
  ) +
  
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```

```{r}
      x = center_x,
      y = center_y,
      xend = center_x + r * cos(human_rad),
      yend = center_y + r * sin(human_rad)
      ), 
    color = "black",
    size = 1.5,
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm"))
  ) +
  # Add the HOG dominant direction arrow
  geom_segment(
    data = arrow_df,
    aes(
      x = center_x,
      y = center_y,
      xend = center_x + r * cos(hog_rad),
      yend = center_y + r * sin(hog_rad)
      ),
    color = "#F0E442",
    size = 1.5,
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm"))
  ) +
  coord_fixed(xlim = c(0, 400), ylim = c(0, 200)) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank()
  )
```
